learned_rules:
- **MIGRATED: buy the pullback, 10–60% off the local high** (owner). It has to hold above the hourly low, with 5m volume ≥ $10k and more buys than sells (V1, V6). Within 10% of the high it's a PASS, blocker "chasing" (near-high skips: 7 ran / 23 dumped; CATCULUS −59%, SI −38%).
- **A spike counts as chasing even 10–20% off the high.** If the last 5m candle is up >25%, or a green spike runs >3x the hourly pace, wait for it to retrace and print a higher low (PILLSEY −31%, V1).
- **Shallow band (10–20% off the high): flow leader only.** It must be the meta's flow leader, with 5m at or above the hourly pace. Otherwise PASS, blocker "flow below pace" (HYPERCHAN #1 never went green).
- **Name the target before buying, ≥ 1.5x from entry.** That's the prior high, the POC, a 0.618 extension or a clean breakout. If the only visible level is below 1.5x, PASS with blocker "target below initials" (SWAN topped at its own 1.4x level).
- **Fresh migration (<1h) going red off the bond spike:** wait for a base above the hourly low (too-new skips: 7 ran / 38 dumped, V1).
- **Vamp field:** buy only the leader by 5m volume and attention, never a 2nd or 3rd copy (V1, V2; FLOATER beat 22 copies; vamp skips 1 ran / 7 dumped).
- **DIP needs a visible higher low.** That means a bounce off the hourly low, a pullback that holds above it, and price now above that pullback low. The thesis breaks under that higher low; if that level is more than 20% below entry, PASS. Never buy the first red-to-green candle (HEXN #1; no-higher-low skips 0 ran / 12 dumped).
- **DIP attention gate:** 5m ≥ 0.7x the hourly average (owner; it doesn't need to be rising), plus a live story with a real crowd. Weak or LARP tech dips are a PASS (HEXN lost twice). Size DIPs by conviction; probation is over.
- **Hack stories: PASS.** That covers hacked projects, exploit/drain headlines and Hack-Inu copies (owner rule).
- **Hard blocks stay:** top 10 >25%, dev >1%, bundles/insiders over the line, mint/freeze live, LP not burned, political figure (V6, V13, V17). Their skips: top 10 7 ran / 33 dumped, dev 0 / 12, bundles 0 / 5, political 0 / 3.
- **Protect green trades before initials.** If 5m volume falls under half its hourly pace, sell half (CPU and FLOAT peaked ~1.6x and closed red). If a trade that already hit ~1.3x triggers a stop review, sell all of it and never trim (PILLSEY).
- **Time stop at 45 min:** exit if under 1.0x with no volume surge (V1). One exception: a coin above $1M that is green on mcap, holding its range low, with 5m ≥ hourly pace, gets a single extension to 90 min (HYPERCHAN #2). No other extensions (FLOAT held to 158 min and lost).
- **Stop review defaults to SELL.** Always sell if the trade never went green, or if top-10/insider share dropped while price bleeds (SI, HEXN, CATCULUS gapped to −36% to −59%). Hold once only with a visible bundle exit and the story and 5m volume clearly intact.
- **Re-enter a stopped coin only when it reclaims its prior high,** never mid-range on a base (CATBOT buy-back −24%).

(2) Small Halloween/spooky theme (rising but thin): Vampinu +512% at $21k; nothing on it has proved itself above $70k (V6). HYPERLOOP ($73k, 6 minutes old, $48k 5m) is watchlist only; I don't snipe pairs that new (V5). Crawler conflicts: Halloweenu is already dead (-93%, $2.6k cap, no buyers), and the LUMI lead isn't in my volume scan, so I won't chase it until I can see it. Out: $LAPTOP (pushed by a political figure, V13), DESSA (above V6 range, fading flow), anything named after a hack. Owner's note: clean setups get rated 8-9 when they earn it, but none is clean yet and the Nov 5 target doesn't make a fading coin a buy.
